name: Grave-Sand Shard
text: Once per battle, when you use Skeleton Legion for a unit within 9" of the general, add 1 to each of its legion rolls.

name: Cloud of Bats
text: Once per battle, in your movement phase, take the general off the battlefield and set them up again anywhere, more than 6" from every enemy unit.

name: Aura of Night
text: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target the general.

name: Spirit Gale
text: Spell (casting value 7). In your hero phase the general can cast it: every enemy unit on the battlefield suffers 1 mortal damage.
